title: Session 2: A Guide to Search Optimization

questions.questionText: What is the main goal of local SEO?
options: Reduce the file size of images
Rank for broad global keywords only
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Improve visibility in location-based searches.

questions.questionText: Which tool is most recommended for submitting local business information so that it appears on Google Maps and local search results?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Google My Business.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of a local keyword?
options: Italian bakery in Agoura Hills, CA
questions.correctAnswer: Italian bakery in Agoura Hills, CA
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Italian bakery in Agoura Hills, CA.

questions.questionText: According to the guide, local searches lead to approximately what percentage of purchases in physical stores?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) 90%.

questions.questionText: Approximately what percentage of users read online reviews before choosing local services?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) 90%.

questions.questionText: What percentage of users use Google Maps to explore local stores and businesses?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) 86%.

questions.questionText: 'Near me' and 'buy now' searches increased by how much in 2020 alone?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) 500%.

questions.questionText: Which link-building strategy supports local SEO?
options: Sharing links with local businesses in exchange for links to their sites
questions.correctAnswer: Sharing links with local businesses in exchange for links to their sites
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Sharing links with local businesses in exchange for links to their sites.

questions.questionText: What does NAP stand for in local SEO?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Name, Address, Phone number.

questions.questionText: Local SEO is an essential part of which type of SEO, since more mobile users search for local businesses?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Mobile SEO.

questions.questionText: Approximately how many searches does Google receive every day that include local searches?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) 1.6 billion.

questions.questionText: Positive online reviews mainly help a local business by:
options: Reducing hosting costs Section 2: Regional SEO (SEO Localization)
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Making it look trustworthy.

questions.questionText: SEO localization is the process of:
options: Adapting website content to the cultural level of a new location
Hosting a site on several servers
questions.correctAnswer: Adapting website content to the cultural level of a new location
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Adapting website content to the cultural level of a new location.

questions.questionText: Which domain extension is a country-code TLD (ccTLD) used to target Canada?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) .ca.

questions.questionText: Which ccTLD indicates a site for the United Kingdom?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) .co.uk.

questions.questionText: Which attribute tells search engines that an alternate language version of a page exists?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) hreflang.

questions.questionText: Which URL structure is an example of a subdirectory?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) domainname.com/uk.

questions.questionText: Which URL is an example of a subdomain structure?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) uk.domainname.com.

questions.questionText: Search engines understand that a site targets a specific country when:
options: The site is hosted on a local IP
Links are built from local resources
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) All of the above.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT an element that should be adapted for a target audience?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Server cabling colour.

questions.questionText: While preparing source text for SEO localization, what must be avoided to prevent search engine penalties?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Keyword stuffing.

questions.questionText: Why should the native currency be displayed on a localized website?
options: Buyers understand the price without conversion
It replaces the need for translation
questions.correctAnswer: Buyers understand the price without conversion
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Buyers understand the price without conversion.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a gTLD?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) .org.

questions.questionText: In the guide's example, how do Amazon's Canadian and Japanese sites differ?
options: By currency and language Section 3: Keyword Research
questions.correctAnswer: By currency and language Section 3: Keyword Research
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) By currency and language Section 3: Keyword Research.

questions.questionText: Keyword research refers to:
options: Identifying the words users search for so they can be used in content
questions.correctAnswer: Identifying the words users search for so they can be used in content
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Identifying the words users search for so they can be used in content.

questions.questionText: Which is a recommended first step in thorough keyword research?
options: Gain good knowledge about the industry
questions.correctAnswer: Gain good knowledge about the industry
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Gain good knowledge about the industry.

questions.questionText: Where can 'Related searches' be found to get more keyword ideas?
options: At the bottom of the Google search results page
questions.correctAnswer: At the bottom of the Google search results page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) At the bottom of the Google search results page.

questions.questionText: Why is it important to think like your customers during keyword research?
options: Different users use different search terms
questions.correctAnswer: Different users use different search terms
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Different users use different search terms.

questions.questionText: Search intent is also known as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) User intent.

questions.questionText: Grouping keywords into themes means, for a site about exercise, using groups such as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) 'sitting exercise', 'standing exercise', 'wall exercise'.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a method of keyword research mentioned in the guide?
options: Participating in forums and community groups
questions.correctAnswer: Participating in forums and community groups
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Participating in forums and community groups.

questions.questionText: Using terms like 'Hardest Cardio Exercises' and 'Hard Cardio Workout' for the same topic shows:
options: Using several search terms for the same topic
questions.correctAnswer: Using several search terms for the same topic
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Using several search terms for the same topic.

questions.questionText: A search for 'Healing backpain through exercise' shows which kind of intent?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Looking for information.

questions.questionText: Keyword research helps a site primarily to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Attract the right visitors.

questions.questionText: After listing important topics, what should be done next?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Rank the topics by importance.

questions.questionText: The guide recommends content matching which of the following?
options: The search intent of the audience
Only the longest keywords Section 4: Keyword Matrix
questions.correctAnswer: The search intent of the audience
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The search intent of the audience.

questions.questionText: A keyword matrix is best described as:
options: A table that organizes keywords with details such as topic, volume, intent and target page
questions.correctAnswer: A table that organizes keywords with details such as topic, volume, intent and target page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A table that organizes keywords with details such as topic, volume, intent and target page.

questions.questionText: Which column would typically be found in a keyword matrix?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Search volume.

questions.questionText: In a keyword matrix, short-tail keywords usually represent:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Broad topics.

questions.questionText: In a keyword matrix, long-tail keywords usually represent:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Sub-topics under a broad topic.

questions.questionText: Keyword cannibalization occurs when:
options: Several pages target the same keyword and compete with each other
questions.correctAnswer: Several pages target the same keyword and compete with each other
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Several pages target the same keyword and compete with each other.

questions.questionText: Mapping keywords to pages in a matrix helps to:
options: Avoid duplicate targeting and plan content
questions.correctAnswer: Avoid duplicate targeting and plan content
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Avoid duplicate targeting and plan content.

questions.questionText: The guide suggests ranking topics by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Monthly search volume.

questions.questionText: Approximately how many long-tail keywords does the guide suggest identifying for each short-tail keyword?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) About 12.

questions.questionText: Which search intent type would be recorded for the keyword 'buy pull-up bar online'?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Transactional.

questions.questionText: What does a keyword difficulty column indicate?
options: How hard it is to rank for the keyword
questions.correctAnswer: How hard it is to rank for the keyword
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) How hard it is to rank for the keyword.

questions.questionText: A matrix of topics (short-tail) against sub-topics (long-tail) is effectively:
options: A content table of contents plan
questions.correctAnswer: A content table of contents plan
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A content table of contents plan.

questions.questionText: Which tool can supply data for filling in a keyword matrix?
options: Squoosh Section 5: Pages per Session (Page/Session Rate) and Bounce Rate
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Google Keyword Planner.

questions.questionText: Pages per session is calculated as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Total pageviews ÷ total sessions.

questions.questionText: If a site recorded 600 pageviews across 200 sessions, what is the pages per session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) 3.

questions.questionText: A higher pages-per-session figure generally suggests:
options: Visitors are more engaged and explore more pages
Visitors never left the home page
questions.correctAnswer: Visitors are more engaged and explore more pages
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Visitors are more engaged and explore more pages.

questions.questionText: A pageview is:
options: A visit from a unique person
An instance of a page being loaded or reloaded in a browser
questions.correctAnswer: An instance of a page being loaded or reloaded in a browser
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) An instance of a page being loaded or reloaded in a browser.

questions.questionText: Unique visitors are:
options: The number of individuals who visited a site in a given period
questions.correctAnswer: The number of individuals who visited a site in a given period
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The number of individuals who visited a site in a given period.

questions.questionText: According to the guide, bounce rate represents:
options: The percentage of visitors who enter the site and leave instead of viewing other pages
The percentage of clicks on ads
questions.correctAnswer: The percentage of visitors who enter the site and leave instead of viewing other pages
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The percentage of visitors who enter the site and leave instead of viewing other pages.

questions.questionText: A session in which the visitor views only one page and leaves is usually counted as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A bounce.

questions.questionText: Which action can help increase pages per session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Adding relevant internal links.

questions.questionText: An SEO-friendly, quality content strategy is expected to lead to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A minimal bounce rate.

questions.questionText: Which is the difference between a session and a pageview?
options: A session is a group of visits/interactions by a user; a pageview is a single page load
questions.correctAnswer: A session is a group of visits/interactions by a user; a pageview is a single page load
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A session is a group of visits/interactions by a user; a pageview is a single page load.

questions.questionText: Which tool can report pages per session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Google Analytics.

questions.questionText: Very low pages per session combined with a high bounce rate may indicate:
options: Content or navigation does not engage visitors
The sitemap is excessive Section 6: Keyword Research Tools
questions.correctAnswer: Content or navigation does not engage visitors
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Content or navigation does not engage visitors.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a keyword research tool?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Google Keyword Planner.

questions.questionText: Which pair are both keyword research tools named in the guide?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Ahrefs and SEMrush.

questions.questionText: Which question can a keyword research tool answer?
options: How many employees work at a company?
What is the estimated monthly search volume for a keyword?
questions.correctAnswer: What is the estimated monthly search volume for a keyword?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) What is the estimated monthly search volume for a keyword?.

questions.questionText: Keyword Planner is a tool provided by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Google.

questions.questionText: Keyword research tools can suggest:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) New keyword ideas.

questions.questionText: A keyword tool can help identify:
options: Relevant terms in the local area
questions.correctAnswer: Relevant terms in the local area
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Relevant terms in the local area.

questions.questionText: Which of these is used to compress images rather than research keywords?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Squoosh.

questions.questionText: The guide suggests using SEO tools such as Google's Keyword Tool and Ahrefs to:
options: Identify search volume and variations of search terms
questions.correctAnswer: Identify search volume and variations of search terms
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Identify search volume and variations of search terms.

questions.questionText: Which tool also offers a Backlink Analytics feature, as shown in the guide?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) SEMrush.

questions.questionText: Why should keyword tool data be compared with search intent?
options: Volume alone does not show whether the keyword matches the audience's purpose
questions.correctAnswer: Volume alone does not show whether the keyword matches the audience's purpose
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Volume alone does not show whether the keyword matches the audience's purpose.

questions.questionText: Long-tail keyword ideas can be found using:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A keyword tool.

questions.questionText: Which is true of keyword research tools?
options: They estimate search volume and competition
They replace content creation Section 7: Google Analytics
questions.correctAnswer: They estimate search volume and competition
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) They estimate search volume and competition.

questions.questionText: Google Analytics is used to:
options: Track and analyze the performance of a website or app
questions.correctAnswer: Track and analyze the performance of a website or app
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Track and analyze the performance of a website or app.

questions.questionText: Who can access Google Analytics?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Anyone with a Google account.

questions.questionText: What is the paid version of Google Analytics called?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Google Analytics 360.

questions.questionText: Where are the standard reports located in the Analytics dashboard?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) On the left side.

questions.questionText: Which of the following metrics can Analytics report?
options: Bounce rate, page views and unique visitors
questions.correctAnswer: Bounce rate, page views and unique visitors
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Bounce rate, page views and unique visitors.

questions.questionText: If a user does not want to browse reports, Analytics allows them to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Ask questions in plain English.

questions.questionText: Which resource helps users learn Analytics?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Analytics Academy.

questions.questionText: Which question can Analytics answer?
options: How many users came from mobile last week?
questions.correctAnswer: How many users came from mobile last week?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) How many users came from mobile last week?.

questions.questionText: What should be clicked on the Analytics welcome page after signing in?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Start measuring.

questions.questionText: Analytics data helps decide which blog content to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Retain, remove or improve.

questions.questionText: Google Analytics differs from Google Search Console in that Analytics mainly:
options: Reports visitor behaviour on the site
questions.correctAnswer: Reports visitor behaviour on the site
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Reports visitor behaviour on the site.

questions.questionText: Google Analytics can show which audience details?
options: Age group of visitors Section 8: Crawling
questions.correctAnswer: Age group of visitors Section 8: Crawling
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Age group of visitors Section 8: Crawling.

questions.questionText: Crawling is the process in which search engines:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Discover and visit web pages.

questions.questionText: Search engine crawlers are also known as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Spiders.

questions.questionText: Google can discover new pages through:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Both of the above.

questions.questionText: Does Google accept payment to crawl a website more frequently?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) No.

questions.questionText: Which file tells crawlers which URLs they can access?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) robots.txt.

questions.questionText: Which directive in robots.txt blocks a crawler from a path?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Disallow.

questions.questionText: Does a sitemap guarantee that a page will be crawled and indexed?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) No, it only improves crawling.

questions.questionText: Which Google tool can request a URL to be crawled or recrawled?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Search Console URL Inspection tool.

questions.questionText: What can prevent efficient crawling, according to the guide?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Session IDs or URL parameters.

questions.questionText: What is the main job of a web crawler?
options: Find and fetch pages to be added to the index
questions.correctAnswer: Find and fetch pages to be added to the index
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Find and fetch pages to be added to the index.

questions.questionText: Crawl errors are:
options: Errors that do not allow search engines to crawl pages
questions.correctAnswer: Errors that do not allow search engines to crawl pages
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Errors that do not allow search engines to crawl pages.

questions.questionText: Which is the order of Google's process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Crawling, indexing, serving Section 9: Indexing.

questions.questionText: Indexing is:
options: The process of understanding and storing information about a page
questions.correctAnswer: The process of understanding and storing information about a page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The process of understanding and storing information about a page.

questions.questionText: Where does Google store analysed page information?
options: In the Google index (a large database)
questions.correctAnswer: In the Google index (a large database)
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) In the Google index (a large database).

questions.questionText: Which element helps Google index images and videos better?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Alternative text and relevant attributes.

questions.questionText: Which page titles does Google index well?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Meaningful and short.

questions.questionText: Mobile-first indexing means Google primarily uses which version of a page for indexing and ranking?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Mobile (smartphone) version.

questions.questionText: In what year did Google enable mobile-first indexing by default for all new websites?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 2019.

questions.questionText: How can indexing of a page be blocked, according to the guide's advice?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Using noindex or password protection.

questions.questionText: Which stage comes after indexing?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Serving search results.

questions.questionText: The Google Search Console index report helps to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) View and fix indexing problems.

questions.questionText: What happens if the Live URL test finds no indexing issues?
options: The page is queued for indexing
questions.correctAnswer: The page is queued for indexing
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The page is queued for indexing.

questions.questionText: Why should the same content be provided on mobile and desktop versions?
options: Because indexing and ranking are based on the mobile version
questions.correctAnswer: Because indexing and ranking are based on the mobile version
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Because indexing and ranking are based on the mobile version.

questions.questionText: Which statement is true?
options: All crawled pages are always indexed
Indexing is the same as ranking
Indexing happens before crawling Section 10: Short-tail Keywords
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Crawling does not guarantee indexing.

questions.questionText: A short-tail keyword usually consists of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Two or three words.

questions.questionText: Short-tail keywords generally represent:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Broad topics.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a short-tail keyword?
options: How to install a pull up bar on a door
Where to buy a cheap pull up bar amazon
Pull up bar for home with parallel grips
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Pull-up bars.

questions.questionText: Long-tail keywords are described in the guide as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Sub-topics of short-tail keywords.

questions.questionText: Long-tail keywords usually contain:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) More than three words.

questions.questionText: Short-tail keywords typically have:
options: Higher search volume and higher competition
questions.correctAnswer: Higher search volume and higher competition
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Higher search volume and higher competition.

questions.questionText: Which is a long-tail keyword for the topic 'pull up bar'?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Pull-up bar for home.

questions.questionText: According to the guide, a long-tail keyword should be used how many times at maximum in a post?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Four times.

questions.questionText: Why are short-tail keywords often harder to rank for?
options: They are broad and many sites compete
questions.correctAnswer: They are broad and many sites compete
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) They are broad and many sites compete.

questions.questionText: In John's gym-equipment example, short-tail keywords are used as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Topics for content.

questions.questionText: Which statement is correct?
options: Long-tail keywords are always one word
Short-tail keywords capture broad interest; long-tail capture specific intent
questions.correctAnswer: Short-tail keywords capture broad interest; long-tail capture specific intent
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Short-tail keywords capture broad interest; long-tail capture specific intent.

questions.questionText: Which is a benefit of combining short-tail and long-tail keywords?
options: It removes the need for titles
Content caters to people with different interests Section 11: Meta Description
questions.correctAnswer: Content caters to people with different interests Section 11: Meta Description
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Content caters to people with different interests Section 11: Meta Description.

questions.questionText: Where is the meta description tag placed in an HTML page?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Inside the <head> section.

questions.questionText: Which is the correct syntax of a meta description?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) <meta name="description" content="..."/>.

questions.questionText: A meta description should:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Briefly summarize the page content.

questions.questionText: Within how many characters should a meta description ideally be kept, as per the guide?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) 155.

questions.questionText: What happens to a meta description longer than the limit?
options: It is deleted from the page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) It is truncated by Google.

questions.questionText: What is the typical maximum length of a title tag before truncation?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) 60 characters.

questions.questionText: Where does the meta description usually appear?
options: In the footer of every page
Under the title in search results as a snippet
questions.correctAnswer: Under the title in search results as a snippet
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Under the title in search results as a snippet.

questions.questionText: A good meta description is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Relevant, unique and compelling.

questions.questionText: Which tag is the first thing visitors see in search results?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Title.

questions.questionText: Should desktop and mobile versions use the same meta descriptions?
options: Yes, same titles and meta descriptions are recommended
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, same titles and meta descriptions are recommended
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Yes, same titles and meta descriptions are recommended.

questions.questionText: An effective meta description may encourage users to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Click the result.

questions.questionText: Meta descriptions and page titles are examples of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) HTML tags to optimize.
